name: Plumbing Inbound Calls

hero.headline: Plumbing Inbound Calls
hero.subheadline: Connect with high-intent consumers actively looking for plumbing solutions.

overview: Plumbing Inbound Calls are consumers who see an offer and dial in themselves, generated by Altarious Global performance campaigns and delivered to your business in real time. Reach homeowners with urgent plumbing emergencies and planned repairs, and connect them with licensed plumbers ready to dispatch.

Plumbing problems are the definition of a call-first category. A homeowner standing in a flooded basement wants to talk to a dispatcher immediately, not submit a web form. Inbound Call programs place local plumbing offers in front of homeowners searching for help and connect them directly to the contractor's phone line. Emergency calls convert at exceptionally high rates when answered promptly, and project inquiries such as water heater replacement allow the CSR to book an in-home estimate on the spot. Call volume can be scheduled to match technician availability, including after-hours emergency coverage.

This product is suited to home services businesses with a team ready to answer during defined hours, a clear view of the consumer they want, and the capacity to convert a live conversation. The acquisition objective is simple: put your team in front of plumbing consumers at the moment they are deciding.
targetConsumer: Homeowners and property managers experiencing a plumbing failure or planning a plumbing project, concentrated in owner-occupied single-family homes. The most valuable segments are emergency callers with active leaks or no hot water, homeowners in older housing stock needing repiping or sewer work, and households replacing water heaters or installing tankless and water treatment systems.
consumerIntent: Typical intent signals include: searching for emergency plumber or plumber near me; active leak, burst pipe or sewer backup in the home; water heater not producing hot water or leaking; recurring drain clogs or slow drains throughout the house.
howGenerated: Calls are generated through call-only and click-to-call performance campaigns targeting searches such as "plumber near me" and "emergency plumber", alongside social and comparison placements. Every source is tracked, so call quality can be traced back to the campaign that produced it.
qualification: Qualification is configured to your appetite. Standard plumbing criteria include: property located within the contractor's service and dispatch area; homeowner or authorised decision maker for the property; nature of the plumbing issue identified and urgency level established; residential or light commercial property type confirmed; ready to schedule a service visit or estimate; not a request for diy advice or parts only.
delivery: Calls are routed to your sales line in real time by state or ZIP, schedule and agent availability, with concurrency limits and daily caps set to your capacity. Call tracking and recording are available for quality control.

process.title: PPC / Traffic Acquisition

faq.q: Can we receive emergency calls after hours?
faq.a: Yes. Delivery schedules are configured around your dispatch availability, including evenings and weekends if you offer emergency service, and can be paused when technicians are fully booked.

faq.q: Can calls be filtered by service type?
faq.a: Screening identifies the plumbing issue so that you can prioritise water heaters, sewer work, drain cleaning or general repairs according to your capabilities and margins.

faq.q: How is the service area defined?
faq.a: Targeting can be set by ZIP code, county or radius from your shop, and adjusted at any time as your technician coverage changes.
